scope.cameras: Two fixed rank-three linear pinhole cameras P3 rationally to P2, with distinct centers.
scope.image_curves: Reduced integral closed projective plane curves, allowing singularities, epipoles, and epipolar lines.
scope.world_curves: Reduced integral closed curves in P3, allowing center and baseline incidence; both camera maps generically defined and each image closure equal to the prescribed image curve.
resolved_outcomes: Existence, including the exhaustive epipolar-line case split.
All possible world degrees and generic projection degree pairs: finite candidate list outside the common epipolar plane, explicit complete numerical spectrum and families inside it.
Necessary-and-sufficient embedded smoothness: reduced-component Jacobian test, finite normalization-map separation/immersion test, and complete common-plane smooth-existence spectrum.
Correct center multiplicities, baseline scheme coefficients, contracted-component exclusions, and reduced-versus-scheme distinctions.
scope.computability: The geometric criteria hold over C. Terminating execution assumes effective exact coefficient input and certified absolute decomposition, e.g. algebraic-number coefficients; arbitrary approximate or unspecified complex constants are not promised exact decisions.

implementation_boundary.proved: A complete algebraic decision criterion using established exact algebraic subroutines.
implementation_boundary.implemented: Finite exact example certificates and a finite monomial-system checker.
implementation_boundary.not_implemented: No general-purpose reconstruction solver, arbitrary-input absolute primary-decomposition engine, normalization engine, or general arbitrary-input smoothness application was implemented.

original_source_and_novelty_limits: This resolves only the explicitly adopted complex fixed-camera integral-curve residual; it does not assert resolution of every reading of the broad AIM Reconstruction Problem 1.4.
Unknown cameras, arbitrary camera models, real visibility, positive characteristic, and reducible-input conventions remain outside this contract.
No novelty claim is made for cone intersection, fiber products, monodromy, primary decomposition, normalization, degree computation, or the Jacobian criterion.
No exhaustive literature-priority or original-problem open-status certificate is asserted.
